name: effect-agents
description: Five hero examples of effectful AI agents built on Effect v4 (beta). One source of truth per example; runs locally with Bun, deploys as one Cloudflare Worker.

scripts.worker:dev: bun run site:build && wrangler dev --config worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.worker:deploy: bun run site:build && wrangler deploy --config worker/wrangler.jsonc
